title: Pure Purrely
summary: Pure Purrely Xyz strategy, revolving around Level 1 monsters that evolve into Rank 2 Epurrelys and Rank 7 Expurrelys through quick Memory Spells. Activating Memory Spells discards a card to Special Summon a Purrely from the Deck and equips continuous effects as attached materials, rapidly stacking 5 or more materials to awaken the tower boss Expurrely Noir.

summary.title: Starters & Setup
points: Purrely: Exciting starter that excavates the top 3 cards of your Deck to add a Purrely Spell/Trap, and reveals a Memory Spell in hand to Rank up into an Epurrely Xyz.
Purrelyly: Searches any continuous Purrely Spell/Trap on summon and targets a Quick-Play Memory Spell in the GY to Rank up into an Epurrely Xyz.
My Friend Purrely: Continuous Spell paying 500 LP to reveal 3 Purrely cards for the opponent to choose 1 to add to hand, and recovers up to 3 Memory Spells when an Xyz leaves the field.
Stray Purrely Street: Field Spell granting targeting protection to newly summoned Purrely monsters and attaching Memory Spells from GY during each End Phase.

summary.title: Opening Play
steps: Normal Summon Purrely or Purrelyly to search or excavate key Spells like My Friend Purrely or Purrely Delicious Memory.
Activate My Friend Purrely to add another Memory Quick-Play Spell to hand.
Activate Purrely Delicious Memory or Purrely Sleepy Memory, discarding 1 card to Special Summon Purrelyly from the Deck.
Use Purrelyly's effect to target the Memory Spell in GY and Xyz Summon Epurrely Plump, attaching the Memory Spell as material.
Use Epurrely Plump's effect to attach up to 2 Spells/Traps from either GY to reach 5 or more attached materials.
Rank up Epurrely Plump directly into Expurrely Noir, which is completely unaffected by the opponent's activated effects.
Set Purrelyeap!? or Purrely Sharely!? to evolve or swap Xyz Monsters on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Expurrely Noir: Tower boss unaffected by activated effects while holding 5+ materials, detaching 2 materials as a Quick Effect to spin an opponent's card to the bottom of the Deck.
Expurrely Happiness: Rank 7 board-breaker that negates all face-up monsters your opponent controls and burns for damage upon attacking.
Epurrely Plump: Rank 2 bridge that hoards GY Spells and Traps and temporarily banishes a monster as a Quick Effect.
Epurrely Beauty & Epurrely Noir: Rank 2 utility bosses providing monster effect negation and Trap searching.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Purrely Sleepy Memory & Purrely Delicious Memory: Core Quick-Plays providing battle and damage protection while granting draw power and stat boosts as materials.
Purrely Happy Memory & Purrely Pretty Memory: Additional Memory Spells enabling multiple attacks and card absorption.
Purrelyeap!? & Purrely Sharely!?: Traps that rank up or swap Xyz Monsters at instant speed to disrupt opponent's interactions.

main: Purrely
Starter: excavates a Purrely Spell/Trap; becomes an Epurrely by revealing a Memory Spell.
Purrelyly
Searches a Purrely card; becomes an Epurrely from a Memory Spell in the GY.
My Friend Purrely
Pays 500 LP to fetch a random Purrely card; recovers Memory Spells when an Xyz leaves.
Purrely Happy Memory
Protects a card; summons a Purrely from the Deck; extra attacks as material.
Purrely Pretty Memory
Both players gain LP; summons a Purrely; attaches their card as material.
Purrely Delicious Memory
Semi-Limited: battle protection; summons a Purrely; ATK as material.
Purrely Sleepy Memory
Semi-Limited: blocks damage; summons a Purrely; draws as material.
Stray Purrely Street
Field Spell: protects new Purrelys; attaches a Memory Spell each End Phase.
Purrely Sharely!?
Newest Trap: swaps the Xyz for another Attribute and copies its Memory Spell.
Purrelyeap!?
Ranks the Xyz into a different Rank for a turn.
